message: The [Cache] aspect cannot be applied to the method '{0}' because the classifier '{1}' marked the parameter '{2}' as ineligible.
rationale: The message says the aspect 'can be applied', which inverts its meaning (the report site in CacheAttribute.BuildAspect reports the error and skips the aspect). It also contains a double space before 'parameter'.
codeChange: The report site (CacheParameterClassification.Ineligible, line 79) passes classifier.ToString() as '{1}', which is the full type name of the classifier unless it overrides ToString. Passing the name given to CachingOptionsBuilder.AddParameterClassifier would be clearer.
